item.title: Owner deceased in January. Believe car abandoned by next of kin., 20th October
item.description:
The elderly female owner sadly died around January 2026. Believed to live close by as she parked here daily. After police attended a male came several days/weeks later and drove it once around the circus (believe he may have been next of kin). He replaced it in original Pay and Display bay and it has not been moved since. Disabled parking badge displayed on dashboard. Vehicle in very poor condition and deteriorating. Risk of vandalism and theft of the disabled parking permit.
Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Gloucester Circus, Greenwich
Report on FixMyStreet
